description: This file is a shell script designed to perform performance testing of the Git filesystem monitoring (FSMonitor) feature. It includes setup routines for repositories, enabling/disabling features like untracked cache and FSMonitor, and runs various test scenarios to measure performance metrics related to repository status and file modifications.

methods.name: enable_uc
methods.description: Enables untracked cache in the specified git repository.

methods.name: disable_uc
methods.description: Disables untracked cache in the specified git repository.

methods.name: start_fsm
methods.description: Starts the FSMonitor daemon and configures the repository to use it.

methods.name: stop_fsm
methods.description: Stops the FSMonitor daemon and unsets the related configuration.

methods.name: do_status
methods.description: Runs 'git status' in the specified repository and measures its performance.

methods.name: do_matrix
methods.description: Sets up a testing scenario with specific configurations of untracked cache and FSMonitor, modifies files, commits, resets, and cleans to evaluate performance under various states.
